back.en: Skin, mucus, cilia, stomach acid, lysozyme in tears and saliva
back.bm: Kulit, mukus, silia, asid perut, lisozim dalam air mata dan air liur

back.en: Lymphocytes produce specific antibodies; memory cells form
back.bm: Limfosit menghasilkan antibodi spesifik; sel ingatan terbentuk

back.en: Antigen: foreign molecule. Antibody: protein that binds it
back.bm: Antigen: molekul asing. Antibodi: protein yang terikat padanya

back.en: Active: body makes antibodies, long-lasting. Passive: antibodies received, short-term
back.bm: Aktif: badan menghasilkan antibodi, tahan lama. Pasif: antibodi diterima, jangka pendek

back.en: Natural: placenta, breast milk (colostrum). Artificial: anti-venom, antitoxin serum
back.bm: Semula jadi: plasenta, susu ibu (kolostrum). Buatan: antibisa, serum antitoksin

back.en: Secondary (with memory cells) is faster, stronger and lasts longer
back.bm: Sekunder (dengan sel ingatan) lebih cepat, kuat dan tahan lama

back.en: HIV destroys T-helper cells; spread by blood, sexual contact, mother to baby
back.bm: HIV memusnahkan sel T-pembantu; tersebar melalui darah, hubungan seks, ibu kepada bayi

back.en: Allergy: overreaction to harmless allergens. Autoimmunity: attacks own cells (lupus, type 1 diabetes)
back.bm: Alahan: tindak balas berlebihan terhadap alergen. Autoimun: menyerang sel sendiri (lupus, diabetes jenis 1)

back.en: A phagocyte moves to a bacterium, engulfs it in a vacuole, and lysosome enzymes digest it
back.bm: Fagosit bergerak ke arah bakteria, menelannya ke dalam vakuol, dan enzim lisosom mencernanya

back.en: Dead or weakened pathogens, or their parts (antigens), that make the body produce antibodies and memory cells
back.bm: Patogen yang mati atau dilemahkan, atau bahagiannya (antigen), yang merangsang badan menghasilkan antibodi dan sel ingatan

back.en: The immune system attacks the donor organ as foreign; immunosuppressant drugs reduce this
back.bm: Sistem imun menyerang organ penderma sebagai benda asing; ubat imunosupresan mengurangkannya
